items.headline: Public meeting on Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review
items.summary: The city held a public scoping meeting for the environmental impact report on the proposed 1250 Oakmead Parkway residential project, with City Council, Heritage Preservation Commission, and Planning Commission members possibly in attendance.

items.headline: Six new single-family homes permitted on Adeline Avenue
items.summary: Six separate single-family homes (Phase 3.1 of the Communications Hill development) were permitted the same day at 802–822 Adeline Avenue, with construction values ranging from about $474,000 to $512,000 each.

items.headline: 147 Homes and Commercial Space Proposed on Homestead Road
items.summary: The Planning Commission is set to act on a subdivision map for 147 housing units plus one commercial building at 3521 and 3591 Homestead Road, processed under state Senate Bill 330.
